code.EVIDENCE_REVIEW_ACCEPTED: Valid evidence review acknowledged; its grade and independence did not change.
code.EVIDENCE_INVALIDATED: Evidence invalidated. Progress and descendant availability are recomputed from remaining evidence.
code.RELEASE_ARCHIVED: Release archived. {learners, plural, =0 {No learners are on it.} one {# learner on it keeps their release, evidence and support.} other {# learners on it keep their release, evidence and support.}}
code.RELEASE_ACTIVATED: Release selected for new learners. Existing enrollments remain pinned.
code.RELEASE_PUBLISHED: Reviewed release published. Existing enrollments remain pinned.
code.RELEASE_APPROVED: Approval recorded for this exact bundle digest.
code.COURSE_SAVED: Course catalog details saved. Published release content is unchanged.
code.DRAFT_CREATED: A validated draft bundle was created. Runtime readiness and review still govern publication.
code.DRAFT_SAVED: Draft bundle validated and saved. Previous approval was cleared.
code.ITEM_DEFECTIVE: Item {assessmentId} marked defective. {evidence, plural, one {# evidence record} other {# evidence records}} for {learners, plural, one {# learner} other {# learners}} were invalidated with the reason.
code.ENROLLMENT_CREATED: Enrollment created for the selected workspace member. No consent or mastery was granted.
code.PROFILE_SAVED: Profile saved. Evidence and mastery are unchanged.
code.PROVIDER_REQUESTED: Metadata request recorded for server operator review. Runtime configuration and verification were not changed.
code.OFFER_PROPOSED: Offer proposed for exact learner acceptance. No grant, allowance debit, work-cap change or deadline change occurred.
code.POLICY_MIGRATED: Reviewed policy migration applied. Existing anchors, pools, grants and ledger history were preserved.
code.PAUSE_APPLIED: Approved pause applied to this learner's window.
code.OUTAGE_APPLIED: Outage adjustment applied to this learner only. Pools and other learners are unchanged.
code.ACCOMMODATION_APPLIED: Accommodation applied to this learner only. Pools and other learners are unchanged.
code.POLICY_SETTINGS_SAVED: Policy settings saved. They apply to new enrollments; existing learners keep their current terms.
code.OFFER_APPROVED: Approved. The learner's accepted terms were granted and the allowance was debited once.
code.OFFER_REJECTED: Offer rejected. No allowance was used.
code.GRANT_REVOKED: Grant revoked. Its usage and history remain in the ledger; no allowance was refunded.
code.ALLOWANCE_REFUNDED: Allowance refunded to the pool. Deadlines are unchanged.
code.EXCEPTION_APPLIED: Exceptional grant applied to this learner only. No allowance pool was debited.
code.COHORT_MIGRATED: Reviewed policy change applied to {count, plural, one {# enrollment} other {# enrollments}}. Anchors, pools, grants and ledger history were preserved.
